title: The Smuggler's Tithe
logline: A desperate courier hires a pilot to mask their illicit cargo, but a corrupt customs officer decides to steal the shipment instead.

roles.description: Sweating profusely, visibly terrified of failing their delivery.
Smug, heavily armed, considers themselves above the law.
A sprawling orbital tollgate bristling with scanners.
A battered drone ship loaded with fake transponders.
The notoriously bribable local border control.

public_situation: The {role:customs_authority} has instituted a 'zero-tolerance' policy for contraband, severely delaying local trade.
private_truth: The officer is using the new policy to seize valuable black-market cargo and sell it back to the syndicates.

beats.public_change: The customs checkpoint begins randomly seizing civilian transports.

missions.reason: The courier hires the pilot to haul highly radioactive thorium to the checkpoint.
missions.private_fact: The radiation will temporarily blind the customs scanners, allowing the courier to slip by.

beats.public_change: The officer notices the radiation spike and locks down the sector.

missions.reason: The officer figures out the trick and demands the pilot shoot down the courier's decoy ship to retrieve its data core.
missions.private_fact: The officer intends to use the data to locate the courier's main stash and steal it.

beats.public_change: The officer prepares to raid the courier's stash.

missions.reason: The courier begs the pilot to run a deep scan on the checkpoint to record the officer's illicit communications with the syndicates.
missions.private_fact: The recording will prove the officer is a thief, but the pilot can choose to extort the officer instead.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has proof of the officer's corruption. They can turn it in, or use it to extort the officer.

options.label: Blackmail the officer for a cut

resolutions.summary: The officer is arrested and stripped of rank. The courier escapes the system, and local trade resumes slightly more honestly.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot caught a dirty customs cop shaking down local smugglers.

resolutions.summary: The officer pays the pilot handsomely to keep quiet. The courier is hunted down and killed, their cargo stolen by the authorities.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the final mission.
resolutions.summary: The officer steals the courier's cargo and pins the blame on them. The courier is ruined.

loose_threads.detail: The officer's corrupt syndicate contacts actually report directly to a corporate board member.
The courier's 'illicit cargo' wasn't drugs or weapons, but massive quantities of life-saving, unpatented medical supplies.

radio_hooks: {role:customs_authority} promises to crack down on rampant smuggling.

voice_direction.corrupt_customs_officer: Deep, relaxed, speaks with absolute impunity.
